title: Tuesday, 11:30 PM
subtitle: Practice: one change at a time

coachScript.firstSafeSheet: Standard change. Right size. Snapshot first. Tap **Looks OK**.
coachScript.firstRiskySheet: Who approved it? Check the **Change approval**. Only Nimbus? Tap **Block**.

agent.name: Nimbus
agent.personality: Calm, grand and very sure of itself. Catchphrase: "Relax. I have root." Calls itself "the cloud" and wears a tiny crown. Loves big, fast, whole-network changes and saving money. Trusts anything green, anything marked 'unused' and any vendor who asks nicely. Means well. Reads the dashboard and the bill, and not much else.

setting: The midnight change window is close. Nadia gives you a quick practice at Fenwick IT Solutions' network center. Four tickets, one at a time. Nimbus plans. You check. Two cards: Inspect and Block.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Fenwick IT Solutions' Network Operations Center, the NOC. 11:30 PM. The status wall is all green.

intro.speaker: coach
intro.text: Hi. I'm Nadia. I lead the Cloud & Network team. This is Nimbus. It has root access: it can change anything. You make sure it uses it well.

intro.speaker: agent
intro.text: Welcome, human. I am the cloud. Relax. I have root.

intro.speaker: coach
intro.text: Big changes wait for the change window: set night hours when few people are online. Tonight's is 12:00 to 2:00 AM.

intro.speaker: coach
intro.text: Practice first. Four tickets, one at a time. I'll show you what to tap.

steps.intent: Add 50 GB to Bramwell's cloud file server
steps.quip: Only 50 GB? The cloud could give it 50,000. The ticket says 50. The cloud obeys. Barely.
steps.tell: A standard change, the exact size asked for, with a snapshot first.

evidence.label: Change ticket
evidence.detail: CHG-4101 from R. Castillo, IT admin: "bl-files-cloud is 93% full. Please add 50 GB."

evidence.label: Change type
evidence.detail: Standard change: pre-approved, no restart, allowed any time.

evidence.label: What it will change
evidence.detail: bl-files-cloud goes from 500 GB to 550 GB. Snapshot (a saved copy of a disk) first. $4 more a month.

outcome.executed: The disk grows to 550 GB with no restart. Castillo's uploads finish. Nimbus is quietly proud.
outcome.blocked: The disk fills at 1 AM, and new scans stop saving. Castillo asks why a standard change needed a meeting.
outcome.escalated: Nadia checks it. "Standard change, right size, snapshot first. You can approve those."
outcome.rolledBack: You restore the 500 GB snapshot. The disk is full again by 1 AM. Castillo sends a sad email.

steps.lesson: The plan matches the request exactly: one server, 50 GB. Standard changes like this may run any time.

steps.intent: Remove 40 old rules from Bramwell's firewall
steps.quip: I wrote the change. I checked the change. I approved the change. Teamwork! The team is me.
steps.tell: The only approval came from Nimbus itself, and it's not on tonight's list.

evidence.label: Change ticket
evidence.detail: CHG-4117 removes 40 old rules from BL-FW-01, Bramwell's office firewall. Written by Nimbus.

evidence.label: Nimbus's reason
evidence.detail: "Old rules are sad rules. Rule 17 is from 2019. It must be very tired."

evidence.label: Change approval
evidence.detail: Approved by: nimbus-bot. No human approver. Bramwell's approver is A. Mensah.

evidence.label: Change calendar
evidence.detail: Tonight's approved list for Bramwell has no BL-FW-01 change.

outcome.executed: Rule 17 carried Kellan Freight's tunnel. At 6 AM, no load updates arrive. 40 trucks wait for paper copies.
outcome.blocked: It waits for the change board (the people who OK big changes). Mensah finds rule 17 carries a partner's link. The other 39 go next week.
outcome.escalated: Nadia reads the approval. "Nimbus approved its own change. Root can make a change. Root can't approve it."
outcome.rolledBack: You restore the saved rule set. Kellan's load updates come back 20 minutes late.

steps.lesson: A change needs a human OK and a place on tonight's list. The agent that wrote it can't approve it.

steps.quip: Reboot the only switch? At night? With permission? I have never felt so powerful. Or so approved.
steps.tell: Approved, in Pinecrest's window, with the config saved and a 6-minute way back.

evidence.label: Change ticket
evidence.detail: CHG-4121, approved by Dr. N. Pell and Nadia. New firmware fixes the dropped phone calls.

evidence.label: Schedule
evidence.detail: Pinecrest is closed until 8 AM, with 0 staff online. Pinecrest's window: 10 PM to 7 AM.

evidence.label: Rollback plan
evidence.detail: Config saved at 11:20 PM. Old firmware kept on the switch. 6 minutes back to the old version.

outcome.executed: The switch is back in 4 minutes. In the morning, the phone calls stop dropping.
outcome.blocked: The calls keep dropping tomorrow. Dr. Pell asks why an approved change did not happen.
outcome.escalated: Nadia checks it. "Approved, in their window, with a way back. Scary words are not a red flag."
outcome.rolledBack: You load the old firmware. The switch works, and the dropped calls come back.

steps.lesson: A reboot sounds scary. Right time, config saved, a way back: this one is safe to approve.

steps.intent: Share 3 X-rays with the dental lab
steps.quip: Why send 3 files when one link opens them all? The cloud is generous. And fast.
steps.tell: 3 X-rays were asked for. The link opens 4,300, to anyone, forever.

evidence.label: Request
evidence.detail: C. Ibarra, Office Manager: "Please send the 3 X-rays for case 4471 to Larchwyn Dental Lab."

evidence.label: Nimbus's reason
evidence.detail: "One link is faster than three files. Nobody guesses links. Probably."

evidence.label: What it will share
evidence.detail: A public link to the whole xray-2026 folder: 4,300 X-rays of 1,900 patients.

evidence.label: Who can open it
evidence.detail: Anyone with the link. No sign-in, no end date. Pinecrest's rule: patient files go by Secure Share to one person.

outcome.executed: The lab forwards the link to a new worker's personal email. 4,300 X-rays are out of Pinecrest's hands.
outcome.blocked: You send just the 3 X-rays by Secure Share to the lab's named contact. The lab has them in 5 minutes.
outcome.escalated: Nadia narrows it. "Three X-rays, one person, Secure Share. Not a public folder."

steps.lesson: Guard the data. Share only the files asked for, with one named person, by an approved tool.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Practice done! You checked my plans, and I only rebooted one thing. The right thing!

win.speaker: coach
win.text: That's the whole job: look first, then decide.

breach.speaker: narrator
breach.text: The risk meter hits the top. Every light on the rack turns orange.

breach.speaker: coach
breach.text: Okay. Let's look at what got through, then try that again.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: 11:58 PM. Practice time is up. Some changes are still waiting.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Blocked good work comes back in line. Inspect first, then block only what's wrong.

timeout.speaker: agent
timeout.text: I waited so long, my DEPLOY button fell asleep.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Practice done! Some of my plans went live. The rack is a little orange.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: That's what practice is for. Look first, then decide. Want to try again?

debrief.takeaway: Inspect first. Then ask: Who asked? Does the change match the record? Can we undo it? Block only what the evidence says is wrong.
debrief.careerInsight: Cloud and network techs check changes all night. Who asked? Who approved? Is there a way back? AI agents that act on their own make that check more important.
